name: Usami Fuuka
source:
[spoiler]Involved in, but survived, a bus accident in Edinburgh, Scotland, at age 12, on the way to her grandmother's house.
Hospitalised at Amanogawa General Hospital and went through a 2-year coma.[/spoiler]
